Dated: 25-08-2026
Corrigendum to the Advertisement for Walk-in-Interview for Engagement of Project
Staff
With reference to the advertisement issued vide Ref. No. CSJMUPro-ERG/105/2026 dated 18-08-2026
regarding the Walk-in-Interview for engagement of Project Staff under various projects at CSJMU, Kanpur, the
following corrections may kindly be noted:
Allconcerned are requested to take note of the above corrections.
1. For the post mentioned at S. No. 3, the designation JRA-“Junior Research Associate" shall be read as
"Junior Research Assistant".
2. The date of Walk-in-Interview, originally mentioned as 26-08-2026, shall be read as 01-09-2026
(Tuesday), as 26-08-2026 is a public holiday. So, this date of Walk-in-Interview is 01-09-2026. The time of
interview (11:00 AM), venue, eligibility criteria, emoluments, duration, and all other terms and
conditions shall remain unchanged.
Registrar
CSJMU
